I was born and raised in a small town nestled in the rolling hills of Vermont. My parents were both educators, instilling in me a love of learning early on. From a young age, I have been curious and eager to explore new ideas. This passion led me to excel in school, particularly in subjects like math and science. In high school, I was involved in several extracurricular activities, including the debate team, robotics club, and student council.

After graduating from high school, I attended a prestigious university on the East Coast, where I pursued a degree in computer science. During my college years, I became fascinated by the potential of technology to solve complex problems and improve people's lives. I joined a research group focused on developing artificial intelligence applications for healthcare and worked on various projects that aimed to diagnose diseases more accurately and efficiently.

Outside of academics, I was an active member of the campus community. I served as a mentor to underclassmen, helping them navigate the challenges of college life. Additionally, I volunteered at a local hospital, assisting patients and providing emotional support. These experiences solidified my desire to use my skills to help others.

Upon graduation, I landed a job at a tech company that shared my values and vision. As a software engineer, I contributed to projects related to healthcare analytics, working alongside medical professionals to create user-friendly tools that could aid in patient care. My colleagues appreciated my dedication, creativity, and ability to collaborate effectively.

In my free time, I enjoy hiking, biking, and exploring the great outdoors. I also have a passion for photography and frequently participate in local art exhibitions. I believe that engaging with diverse perspectives and cultures enriches my own life and broadens my horizons.

Recently, I decided to pursue a master's degree in data science to further enhance my skillset and contribute to cutting-edge research. I am excited about the opportunities ahead and remain committed to making a positive impact on society through my work in technology and innovation.
